live_benchmark_suite.how_to_use: load via each task's loader, use the fixed reproducible split, report the metric, and try to beat the named KODEX baseline_code
live_benchmark_suite.verdict: 3 open, citable fusion-ML tasks (CGYRO turbulence, MAST disruption, flux ROM) with real on-disk data + reproducible KODEX baselines — a community leaderboard starting point, not a private result

caveat: small by mainstream-ML standards (CGYRO = 16 pts); honest pilot fusion-ML benchmarks
